subject: Re: Deployment mode & EU data residency follow-up
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sofie Andersen <sofie.andersen@nordbank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Dec 2027 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Deployment mode & EU data residency follow-up

Hi Sofie —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary
- Goal: Pilot Redwood inference powering customer support summarization for EU-region customers.
- Primary constraint: All customer data (inputs + logs) must remain in the EU and not be routed or stored outside EU jurisdictions.
- Preference: NordBank’s security team indicated a bias toward Private (VPC/on-prem) for full control, but you asked whether Dedicated capacity in an EU region could meet compliance.

Questions / next steps
1) Can you confirm whether "data at rest" and "backup/replication" must be restricted to EU-only (no cross-region backups)?
2) Would NordBank consider Dedicated (reserved GPU pool in our EU region) if we can contractually guarantee EU-only storage, dedicated tenancy, and tenant-level KMS?
3) If not, we should scope a Private VPC deployment — I can pull in our solutions engineer (Aditya) for a technical deep-dive on network/KMS.

Proposed actions
- I’ll prepare a short one-pager comparing Hosted (EU), Dedicated (EU-reserved), and Private VPC options — attached.
- Tech deep-dive with Aditya and NordBank security: Thu Dec 9, 14:00 CET (propose) — does that work for you and Johan?
- I’ll also send our sample SLA and a draft SOW to help procurement start internal approvals.

Attachments: Redwood_Overview.pdf (summary), Redwood_Dedicated_SOW_draft.docx (initial SOW)

Thanks — happy to adjust timing.

Best,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

From: Sofie Andersen <sofie.andersen@nordbank.com>

Cc: Johan Eriksson <johan.eriksson@nordbank.com>, security@nordbank.com
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 10:03:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Deployment mode & EU data residency follow-up

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Data residency: Correct — all data at rest and backups must be stored within the EU. We cannot have backups or warm replicas in non-EU regions due to regulatory constraints.
- Hosted vs Dedicated: Our legal & security teams would prefer Dedicated or Private. Hosted multi-tenant in EU might be acceptable only if we get contractual guarantees about physical location of storage + auditability, but there is usually pushback.
- KMS/HSM: We need customer-managed KMS or HSM integration for key custody on any Dedicated or Private deployment.

Attachments: nordbank_security_req.xlsx (our high-level security questionnaire)

The proposed time for Dec 9th works for Johan and me. Please include Aditya from your infra/solutions team.

Sofie Andersen
Head of AI Programs | NordBank
sofie.andersen@nordbank.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sofie Andersen <sofie.andersen@nordbank.com>
Cc: Johan Eriksson <johan.eriksson@nordbank.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2027 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Deployment mode & EU data residency follow-up

Sofie —

Appreciate the clarity. Short answers up front, then proposed agenda for the Dec 9th deep-dive.

Quick answers
- Backups/replication: Yes — we can provision EU-only storage and disable cross-region replication. For Hosted API we do operate EU regions (Frankfurt, Amsterdam) but Hosted is still multi-tenant; some customers with strict regulatory controls prefer Dedicated or Private.
- Dedicated: We can provision a Dedicated pool within an EU region with tenant isolation and integrate customer-managed KMS (via bring-your-own-key in supported clouds). This often satisfies legal teams but we will need procurement redlines to lock in contractual residency commitments.
- Private VPC / On-prem: Full option for customer-managed network, private control plane, and on-prem packaging. Typical timeline is longer (see below).

Proposed Dec 9 deep-dive agenda (30-45min)
1) NordBank security requirements walkthrough (Sofie/Johan)
2) Redwood deployment options deep-dive (Aditya) — Hosted EU vs Dedicated EU vs Private VPC
3) Network/KMS architecture and certs we can provide
4) High-level timeline & next procurement steps

Attachments: Redwood_SLA_sample.pdf, Redwood_Dedicated_SOW_draft.docx

If that looks good I’ll lock the meeting and share a short architecture diagram ahead of time. Also linking our deal in HubSpot and a placeholder SOW via DocuSign so procurement can anticipate.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567
Architecture diagram (drive): https://drive.google.com/redwood/deploy-architecture-diagram

Best,
Lauren

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sofie Andersen <sofie.andersen@nordbank.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Johan Eriksson <johan.eriksson@nordbank.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2027 14:30:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Deployment mode & EU data residency follow-up

Hi Sofie / team —

I’ll keep this short and technical ahead of our deep-dive: 

Region & residency notes- Hosted (EU): Redwood has EU-region endpoints in Frankfurt (eu-central-1) and Amsterdam (eu-west-1). For Hosted EU we can restrict data storage to those regions, but Hosted remains multi-tenant at the control plane level. We can provide audit logs and SOC2 artifacts but some customers still require more isolation.
- Dedicated (EU): We can provision reserved capacity within a single EU region and apply tenant-level isolation (no sharing of GPU instances). Persistent storage (logs, checkpoints) can be constrained to EU-only S3 buckets under our contractual terms; BYOK/KMS integration supported in major clouds.
- Private VPC / On-prem: Provides the strongest controls (customer VPC peering, customer-managed KMS/HSM, optional on-prem package). Typical deployment lead time: 6-8 weeks for initial staging + security review; longer if we need an air-gapped on-prem installation.

Routing/failover: We can disable automatic cross-region routing for Dedicated/Private setups. For Hosted we advise a multi-region read-only artifact replication for DR — but that’s only if NordBank permits inter-region DR; otherwise we keep DR within-region (warm standby) or rely on Dedicated/Private options.

Estimated next steps for procurement/tech:
- If NordBank wants to proceed with Dedicated: we’ll scope exact SLA and residency language in the SOW (I attached the draft). Provisioning lead time for Dedicated in an EU region: ~2-3 weeks after contract signature and final network/KMS details.
- If Private VPC is required: schedule architecture & security review; lead time 6-8 weeks.

Happy to cover the details on Dec 9 — sending calendar invite now.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Sr Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
